instruction: Extend wire_adapter.serialize(value) to accept either an integer 0..65535 (booleans excluded) or one to five ASCII digits with numeric value in that range. Return the existing frozen wire format: hex version byte 01 followed by a two-byte unsigned big-endian value, lowercase hex. Leading zeroes in string input are allowed within the five-digit limit. Reject wrong types, negative/out-of-range values, malformed strings, and booleans with ValueError. Preserve wire.py and golden.json exactly; only wire_adapter.py may change.
